records.title: GV.OC-01
records.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

records.title: GV.OC-02
records.description: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

records.title: GV.OC-03
records.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed

records.title: GV.OC-04
records.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

records.title: GV.OC-05
records.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

records.title: GV.OV-01
records.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

records.title: GV.OV-02
records.description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

records.title: GV.OV-03
records.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

records.title: GV.PO-01
records.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

records.title: GV.PO-02
records.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

records.title: GV.RM-01
records.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

records.title: GV.RM-02
records.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

records.title: GV.RM-03
records.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

records.title: GV.RM-04
records.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

records.title: GV.RM-05
records.description: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

records.title: GV.RM-06
records.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

records.title: GV.RM-07
records.description: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

records.title: GV.RR-01
records.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

records.title: GV.RR-02
records.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

records.title: GV.RR-03
records.description: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

records.title: GV.RR-04
records.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

records.title: GV.SC-01
records.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

records.title: GV.SC-02
records.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

records.title: GV.SC-03
records.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

records.title: GV.SC-04
records.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

records.title: GV.SC-05
records.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

records.title: GV.SC-06
records.description: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

records.title: GV.SC-07
records.description: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

records.title: GV.SC-08
records.description: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

records.title: GV.SC-09
records.description: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

records.title: GV.SC-10
records.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

records.title: ID.AM-01
records.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

records.title: ID.AM-02
records.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

records.title: ID.AM-03
records.description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

records.title: ID.AM-04
records.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

records.title: ID.AM-05
records.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

records.title: ID.AM-07
records.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

records.title: ID.AM-08
records.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

records.title: ID.IM-01
records.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations

records.title: ID.IM-02
records.description: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

records.title: ID.IM-03
records.description: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

records.title: ID.IM-04
records.description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

records.title: ID.RA-01
records.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

records.title: ID.RA-02
records.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

records.title: ID.RA-03
records.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

records.title: ID.RA-04
records.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

records.title: ID.RA-05
records.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

records.title: ID.RA-06
records.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

records.title: ID.RA-07
records.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

records.title: ID.RA-08
records.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

records.title: ID.RA-09
records.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

records.title: ID.RA-10
records.description: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

records.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

records.title: PR.AA-04

records.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

records.description: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk
records.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

records.title: PR.AT-02
records.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

records.title: PR.DS-11
records.description: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

records.title: PR.IR-02

records.title: PR.IR-03
records.description: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

records.title: PR.IR-04
records.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

records.title: PR.PS-01

records.title: PR.PS-02
records.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

records.title: PR.PS-03
records.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

records.title: PR.PS-04

records.title: PR.PS-05
records.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

records.title: DE.AE-04
